svg.title: Three goal types — one volleyball situation
svg.desc: Process actions can support performance and outcomes. Arrows show possible support, not increasing control or guaranteed results.

g.text: Three goal types — one volleyball situation
Process actions can support performance and outcomes.
Process: use my practised preparation routine
Usually more directly controllable than the final result.
Performance: reach a target serving percentage
A personal standard, influenced by execution and conditions.
Also depends on opponents, teammates and circumstances.
Arrows show possible support, not increasing control or guaranteed results.
